name: Beatriz Fernandes Costa
headline: Junior UX/Product Designer
summary: Junior UX/Product Designer with 2 years of experience creating user-centered digital experiences. Skilled in wireframing, prototyping, and conducting basic usability research to support product decisions. Collaborative team player passionate about translating user needs into intuitive interfaces.

responsibilities: Assisted senior designers in creating wireframes and prototypes for mobile applications
Conducted user interviews and compiled feedback reports
Participated in design critique sessions to refine UI components
Helped maintain the company's design system in Figma
Designed low and high-fidelity prototypes for web and mobile products
Collaborated with product managers and developers to define user flows
Conducted usability tests with 5-10 participants per sprint cycle
Iterated on designs based on user feedback and analytics data
Contributed to the creation of a scalable component library
